question_text: A 27-year-old woman presents to your office complaining of right arm numbness and weakness. Her past medical history is unremarkable. On physical exam, her bicep, brachioradialis, and patellar reflexes are 2+ bilaterally. CNS imaging shows no abnormalities. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
